name: composio
tagline_zh: 想让 Agent 真的替你发邮件、建 issue、改 Notion，卡在授权和 SDK 上最耗人。它把首次配置。
tagline_en: Agent can't actually send mail or file issues until auth and SDK setup are done. This walks first-time config.
desc_en: Route and complete Composio work across Composio For You and Composio Platform. Use when the user mentions Composio; wants an agent to use apps such as Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Calendar, or Linear; needs first-time setup, an SDK or MCP integration, CLI operation, migration guidance, current documentation, or help diagnosing a connection or tool call.
why_zh: 它区分 Composio For You 和 Platform 两条线，按你手上的场景选路。
why_en: It splits Composio For You from Platform and routes by your actual scenario, instead of dumping generic docs for you to assemble.
limit_zh: 只管 Composio 这一层：账号、API key、目标应用的 OAuth 授权都得你自己先备好。
limit_en: Covers Composio only: you must already have an account, API key and OAuth grants for target apps. It won't register third-party services or.
title_en: Composio wiring for Gmail, Slack, GitHub and more
